blogPosts.title: How Much Does a Complete Garden Makeover Cost in Belmont?
blogPosts.excerpt: A detailed breakdown of garden makeover costs for Belmont homeowners, covering site preparation, retaining walls, decking, planting, and artificial turf across Geelong.
body: A complete garden makeover is one of the best investments Belmont homeowners can make, but understanding the costs involved is essential before breaking ground. At The Planted Space, we have been transforming outdoor spaces across Geelong for over a decade, and we know that every garden is unique. Factors like your property's slope, existing soil conditions, access for machinery, and the scope of work all play a role in determining your final investment. In this guide, we will break down realistic cost ranges for Belmont garden makeovers, explain what drives those costs, and help you plan a budget that delivers genuine value for your Geelong property.

The starting point for most Belmont garden makeovers is site preparation, which typically ranges from $1,500 to $4,000 depending on how much clearing, leveling, and waste removal is required. Geelong's varied terrain, from the flat blocks near Belmont's centre to the steeper properties closer to the Barrabool Hills, can significantly affect this cost. Retaining walls are another major factor, with prices ranging from $200 to $600 per linear metre depending on materials. Timber sleepers are the most affordable option, while natural stone or concrete block walls command a premium but deliver exceptional longevity in Geelong's coastal climate.

Soft landscaping, the plants, garden beds, mulching, and soil preparation that bring your garden to life, typically accounts for 20 to 35 percent of a total garden makeover budget in Belmont. In the Geelong region, we recommend allocating extra budget for soil improvement, as the clay-heavy soils common across Belmont and neighbouring suburbs like Highton and Grovedale require genuine amendment for optimal plant health. Premium plant stock suited to Geelong's coastal conditions, including salt-tolerant species and wind-resistant varieties, costs more upfront but dramatically reduces replacement rates. A well-planted Belmont garden should thrive for decades with minimal ongoing intervention.

Hard landscaping elements like pathways, paving, decking, and outdoor structures represent the largest portion of most Belmont garden makeover budgets. A quality timber deck measuring around 20 square metres will typically cost between $5,000 and $12,000, while concrete or stone pathways range from $80 to $150 per square metre. For Belmont properties with significant level changes, combining retaining walls with terraced garden beds is a smart investment that creates usable space while managing erosion. At The Planted Space, we source durable, treated materials specifically chosen for Geelong's coastal moisture and UV exposure, ensuring your hard landscaping looks excellent for years to come.

So what should a Belmont homeowner expect to invest in a complete garden makeover? For a solid, professional transformation of a standard-sized suburban block, budgets typically range from $15,000 to $35,000. Larger properties or those requiring significant earthworks, premium materials, and extensive planting can comfortably reach $50,000 or more. The key is matching your budget to your priorities. If outdoor entertaining is the goal, investing more in decking and paving delivers the best lifestyle return. If low maintenance is the priority, spending on quality artificial turf and drought-tolerant planting pays dividends over time. We provide detailed, fixed-price quotes so there are no surprises.

Smart Belmont homeowners get the most value from their garden makeover by planning thoroughly before any work begins. We always recommend starting with a professional site assessment. At The Planted Space, we offer free on-site consultations across Belmont and the greater Geelong area to discuss your vision, assess your property's conditions, and identify potential cost-saving opportunities. Choosing locally proven plant species, using materials suited to Geelong's climate, and tackling work in logical phases can all help stretch your budget further. Avoid the temptation to cut corners on drainage and soil preparation, as these hidden elements are what separate a garden that thrives from one that struggles.

If you are considering a garden makeover in Belmont or anywhere across Geelong, The Planted Space is here to help you plan and execute a transformation that suits your lifestyle and budget. We handle everything from initial design through to final planting, with personal attention to every detail. Contact us on 0499 558 574 or send an enquiry through our website to arrange your free consultation. Whether you are looking to create an outdoor entertaining area, install low-maintenance artificial turf, or completely reimagine your backyard, we will provide honest advice and a transparent quote with no lock-in obligations.

blogPosts.title: Best Low-Maintenance Plants for Geelong's Coastal Climate
blogPosts.excerpt: A landscaper's guide to the toughest, most beautiful low-maintenance plants for Belmont and Geelong gardens, from native grasses to flowering shrubs.
body: One of the most common requests we hear from Belmont and Geelong homeowners is for a garden that looks fantastic without demanding every weekend of their time. The secret to a genuinely low-maintenance garden is not just choosing tough plants, it is selecting species that are specifically adapted to Geelong's unique coastal climate. With its mix of salt-laden winds, clay-heavy soils, hot dry summers, and cool damp winters, the Geelong region presents distinct challenges that generic garden centre plants often cannot handle. After years of designing and planting gardens across Belmont, Highton, Waurn Ponds, and the Bellarine, we have developed a tried-and-tested list of low-maintenance plants that truly thrive.

Starting with structural plants, native grasses are the backbone of any low-maintenance Geelong garden. Lomandra Tanika is an absolute workhorse, it tolerates Geelong's coastal winds, handles clay soils without complaint, and stays green year-round with virtually no care. For taller screening, Westringia fruticosa, commonly known as Coastal Rosemary, forms dense, neat hedges that shrug off salt spray and thrive in Belmont's exposed conditions. Dianella Little Rev provides reliable blue-green foliage and attractive berries with minimal watering once established. These structural plants form the framework of a garden that looks intentional and polished even when you are too busy to step outside for weeks at a time.

For colour and seasonal interest without the maintenance burden, Geelong's coastal climate supports several excellent choices. Grevillea Moonlight delivers striking white and pink spider flowers throughout winter and spring, attracting native birds to your Belmont garden while requiring almost no attention. Kangaroo Paw varieties like Bush Gem thrive in Geelong's conditions, providing bold red, yellow, or orange flowers from a plant that actually prefers poor soil and infrequent watering. Rosemary is practically indestructible in this region, it handles the coastal winds, the clay soil, and the seasonal rainfall swings while giving you fresh herbs and aromatic foliage year-round.

Groundcovers are where you can save the most time and money in a Belmont garden. Instead of fighting to maintain perfect lawn edges, consider planting Myoporum parvifolium, a dense, flat groundcover that smothers weeds and tolerates light foot traffic. For shaded areas under existing trees, Viola hederacea, known as Native Violet, creates a lush, green carpet with delicate purple flowers, thriving in the dappled light common in established Belmont gardens. If you still want some lawn, Zoysia varieties are an excellent low-maintenance option for the Geelong climate, they grow slowly, need less mowing, and stay green through summer with minimal irrigation.

The real key to low-maintenance gardening in Belmont is not just plant selection, it is the preparation and design that goes in before a single plant goes into the ground. At The Planted Space, we always start with proper soil improvement, incorporating organic matter into Geelong's clay soils to improve drainage and reduce ongoing watering needs. We mulch generously with quality bark or stone mulch, which suppresses weeds, retains moisture, and gives every garden a polished, finished appearance. Grouping plants by their water and sun requirements, a technique we use on every Belmont project, means your irrigation is efficient and your maintenance routine is simplified.

Artificial turf is another increasingly popular option for Geelong homeowners who want a green, usable lawn without any of the traditional maintenance. Modern artificial grass products are remarkably realistic, handle heavy foot traffic, and withstand Geelong's UV exposure without fading. For families with children or pets in Belmont, artificial turf eliminates mud, mowing, and chemical treatments while providing a safe, soft surface year-round. We recommend premium-grade, Australian-made products with proper drainage systems designed for Geelong's rainfall patterns. When installed correctly with the right base preparation, quality artificial turf lasts 15 to 20 years, making it an excellent long-term investment.

Creating a low-maintenance garden in Belmont or anywhere across Geelong starts with understanding your specific site conditions and choosing plants that work with the local climate, not against it. At The Planted Space, we combine years of local experience with genuine horticultural knowledge to design gardens that look after themselves. If you would like to discuss transforming your Belmont garden into a beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor space, call us on 0499 558 574 or send an enquiry through our website. We offer free on-site consultations across Belmont, Highton, Grovedale, Waurn Ponds, and the wider Geelong area, and we are always happy to share advice on making your garden work harder so you can work less.

blogPosts.title: Retaining Walls in Belmont: Materials, Costs and What to Expect
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Belmont and Geelong homeowners need to know about retaining walls, including material options, council regulations, engineering requirements, and realistic costs.
body: Retaining walls are one of the most common and most valuable landscaping projects in Belmont and across the Geelong region. With the area's mix of flat coastal plains and undulating hillsides, many properties need retaining walls to manage sloped sections, prevent erosion, and create level areas for gardens, entertaining spaces, or pool surrounds. At The Planted Space, we have built retaining walls throughout Belmont, Highton, Waurn Ponds, and surrounding suburbs, and we understand the specific engineering requirements, soil conditions, and Geelong council regulations that govern these structures. Whether you need a simple garden bed edge or a significant structural wall, knowing your options upfront saves time, money, and headaches.

Timber sleeper retaining walls are the most popular choice for Belmont gardens, and for good reason. They are cost-effective, suit a wide range of garden styles, and can be constructed relatively quickly. Treated pine sleepers typically cost between $200 and $350 per linear metre installed, making them an excellent option for garden beds and low walls up to one metre in height. For Belmont's clay soils, proper drainage behind timber walls is absolutely critical, without it, hydrostatic pressure builds up and can push the wall out of alignment within a few seasons. We always install agricultural drainage pipe behind our timber retaining walls to manage water flow and protect your investment.

For a more premium finish, concrete block and natural stone retaining walls offer exceptional durability and visual appeal. Concrete block walls typically range from $350 to $600 per linear metre installed, depending on the block type, wall height, and complexity of the project. In Belmont, these walls are particularly popular for front-of-property applications where appearance matters most. Natural stone walls command a premium, often $500 to $900 per linear metre, but deliver a timeless, high-end look that significantly boosts property value. Both options handle Geelong's coastal conditions well, resisting salt air damage and moisture that can deteriorate lesser materials over time.

Geelong council regulations play a significant role in retaining wall projects, and it is essential to understand what approvals you may need before construction begins. In the City of Greater Geelong, retaining walls over one metre in height generally require a building permit, and walls that affect neighbouring properties may need additional approvals. At The Planted Space, we handle the entire process for Belmont clients, from initial site assessment through to any required permits, ensuring your wall is fully compliant with local regulations. We also assess soil conditions, drainage requirements, and structural loads specific to your Belmont property, because getting these fundamentals right is what separates a wall that lasts decades from one that needs expensive repairs.

The engineering behind a retaining wall is just as important as the visible finish. Geelong's clay soils expand and contract significantly with seasonal moisture changes, creating enormous pressure on retaining structures. For walls over 600mm, proper engineering calculations are essential to determine footing size, wall thickness, and reinforcement requirements. We work with qualified engineers on larger Belmont retaining wall projects, ensuring every wall is designed to handle the specific soil loads and drainage conditions of your property. This investment in proper engineering upfront prevents the costly failures we see from DIY and budget retaining walls across the Geelong region every year.

Beyond structural requirements, retaining walls offer enormous design potential for Belmont gardens. A well-designed wall becomes a design feature in its own right, incorporating integrated seating, planting pockets, lighting, or water features that transform a functional necessity into a stunning focal point. We have created tiered retaining wall systems throughout Belmont that turn unusable slopes into terraced garden beds, each with its own microclimate and planting scheme. Combining different materials, timber walls with stone capping, or concrete blocks with timber accents, adds visual interest and character. At The Planted Space, we approach every retaining wall project as a design opportunity, not just an engineering challenge.

If your Belmont property needs a retaining wall, whether it is a simple garden bed edge or a major structural project, The Planted Space has the experience and expertise to deliver a result that is built to last. We provide free on-site assessments across Belmont and the greater Geelong area, assessing your site conditions, discussing your options, and providing transparent, fixed-price quotes. Call us on 0499 558 574 or send an enquiry through our website to arrange your consultation. From Belmont to Highton, Waurn Ponds to Grovedale, we are the Geelong team that builds retaining walls properly the first time.

blogPosts.title: Is Artificial Turf Right for Your Belmont Home? Pros, Cons and Costs
blogPosts.excerpt: A comprehensive guide to artificial turf for Belmont and Geelong homeowners, covering costs, installation, maintenance savings, and whether it suits your property.
body: Artificial turf has come a long way in Australia, and for many Belmont homeowners, it has become the smart solution to a perennial problem, maintaining a green, usable lawn in Geelong's variable climate. At The Planted Space, we install premium artificial turf across Belmont and the wider Geelong region, and we have seen demand grow significantly over the past five years. But is artificial turf the right choice for your specific property? In this guide, we will walk through the genuine pros and cons of artificial grass for Belmont homes, break down realistic costs, and help you decide whether this increasingly popular option suits your lifestyle, your budget, and your Geelong block.

The advantages of artificial turf for Belmont homeowners are compelling. The most obvious benefit is maintenance elimination, no mowing, no watering, no fertilising, and no weekend spent wrestling with lawn edges. For busy Geelong families, this reclaimed time is genuinely life-changing. Artificial turf also stays green and presentable year-round, regardless of Geelong's summer droughts or winter rains. For households with children and pets, modern artificial grass provides a clean, soft, mud-free surface that handles heavy use without developing bare patches. In Belmont's climate, where summer temperatures can push above 35 degrees and rainfall is unpredictable, a lawn that looks perfect every day without any effort has obvious appeal.

There are also some genuine disadvantages to consider before committing to artificial turf in Belmont. The upfront cost is significant, premium installed artificial turf typically ranges from $80 to $130 per square metre, meaning a standard 40 square metre lawn area will cost between $3,200 and $5,200 fully installed. In Geelong's summer heat, artificial turf can become uncomfortably hot underfoot, particularly on north-facing areas with direct sun exposure. While modern products incorporate cooling technologies, they do not completely solve this issue. Some Belmont homeowners also miss the natural feel and biodiversity that a real lawn provides, artificial turf does not support insects, does not absorb carbon, and does not develop the character of a living garden over time.

The installation process is where artificial turf success or failure is determined, and this is especially true in the Geelong region. Proper base preparation is critical, we excavate the existing lawn, install a compacted crusher dust base, and ensure adequate drainage to handle Geelong's occasional heavy downpours. Cutting corners on base preparation is the most common cause of artificial turf problems we see on Belmont properties, including uneven surfaces, poor drainage, and premature deterioration. The turf itself should be Australian-made, UV-stabilised to handle Geelong's harsh summer sun, and suited to the intended use, whether that is children's play, pet areas, or decorative front-of-house applications.

Cost-wise, artificial turf represents a genuine long-term saving for most Belmont households when compared to the ongoing expense of maintaining a real lawn. Between water bills, fertiliser, lawn care products, equipment, and the value of your time, maintaining a natural lawn in Geelong typically costs $800 to $1,500 per year. Over a 15-year lifespan, which is realistic for quality artificial turf installed correctly, those savings add up significantly. When you factor in Belmont property values and the kerb appeal that a consistently green lawn provides, the return on investment becomes even more compelling. We provide detailed, itemised quotes so you can make an informed decision.

Blending artificial turf with real planting is a strategy we use frequently on Belmont projects to get the best of both worlds. A strip of quality artificial turf in the main play or entertaining area, surrounded by garden beds filled with drought-tolerant native plants and feature trees, creates a low-maintenance garden that still feels alive and natural. This hybrid approach works particularly well in Belmont, where typical block sizes give you enough space for both functional lawn area and attractive garden borders. We can also incorporate stepping stones, garden edging, and mulched pathways to create visual separation between artificial and natural elements, resulting in a cohesive, professionally designed outdoor space.

If you are wondering whether artificial turf is the right solution for your Belmont property, the best next step is a free on-site consultation with The Planted Space. We will visit your Geelong home, assess the specific conditions of your lawn area, including sun exposure, drainage, soil type, and intended use, and provide honest, straightforward advice about whether artificial turf makes sense for your situation. If it does, we will supply and install premium Australian-made turf backed by a comprehensive warranty. Call us on 0499 558 574 or send an enquiry through our website to arrange your free Belmont consultation today.
